proxy.traefik:
# Traefik reference config for netbox, generated by the hub from its image.yml.
# Labels for the netbox service in your compose file. Traefik's docker provider must reach the netbox
# container on a shared network; the entrypoint websecure and the certificate resolver letsencrypt are
# examples from a typical Traefik setup. Replace example.com with your domain. Websockets need nothing extra.
services:
  netbox:
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.http.services.netbox.loadbalancer.server.port=8000
      - traefik.http.routers.netbox.rule=Host(`netbox.example.com`)
      - traefik.http.routers.netbox.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.netbox.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.netbox.service=netbox
      # Authentication: uncomment one; the middleware is defined in your Traefik config.
      # - traefik.http.routers.netbox.middlewares=authelia@docker
      # - traefik.http.routers.netbox.middlewares=authentik@docker

kubernetes:
# Netbox: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-netbox/blob/master/image.yml
# Storage sizes are placeholders; secrets belong in a Secret, not this ConfigMap.
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: netbox-env
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: netbox
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
data:
  PUID: '1000'
  PGID: '1000'
  TZ: Etc/UTC
  SUPERUSER_EMAIL: ''
  SUPERUSER_PASSWORD: ''
  ALLOWED_HOST: ''
  DB_NAME: ''
  DB_USER: ''
  DB_PASSWORD: ''
  DB_HOST: ''
  DB_PORT: ''
  REDIS_HOST: ''
  REDIS_PORT: ''
  REDIS_USERNAME: ''
  REDIS_PASSWORD: ''
  REDIS_DB_TASK: ''
  REDIS_DB_CACHE: ''
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: netbox-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: netbox
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: netbox
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: netbox
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: netbox
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: netbox
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: netbox
        image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/netbox:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: netbox-env
        ports:
        - name: port-8000
          containerPort: 8000
          protocol: TCP
        volumeMounts:
        - name: netbox-config
          mountPath: /config
      volumes:
      - name: netbox-config
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: netbox-config
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: netbox
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: netbox
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: netbox
  ports:
  - name: port-8000
    port: 8000
    targetPort: 8000
    protocol: TCP
quadlet:
# netbox.container: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-netbox/blob/master/image.yml
# Optional parameters are commented out.

[Unit]
Description=Netbox (LinuxServer.io)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Container]
Image=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/netbox:latest
ContainerName=netbox
AutoUpdate=registry
Environment=PUID=1000
Environment=PGID=1000
Environment=TZ=Etc/UTC
Environment=SUPERUSER_EMAIL=
Environment=SUPERUSER_PASSWORD=
Environment=ALLOWED_HOST=
Environment=DB_NAME=
Environment=DB_USER=
Environment=DB_PASSWORD=
Environment=DB_HOST=
Environment=DB_PORT=
Environment=REDIS_HOST=
Environment=REDIS_PORT=
Environment=REDIS_USERNAME=
Environment=REDIS_PASSWORD=
Environment=REDIS_DB_TASK=
Environment=REDIS_DB_CACHE=
# Environment=BASE_PATH=
# Environment=CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=
# Environment=REMOTE_AUTH_ENABLED=
# Environment=REMOTE_AUTH_BACKEND=
# Environment=REMOTE_AUTH_HEADER=
# Environment=REMOTE_AUTH_AUTO_CREATE_USER=

[Service]

TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
